scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix server && node server/dist/index.js
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
